description.value: Once per long rest, as a rest action, you can sunbathe in direct sunlight to soak up energy from the sun to regain expended @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.SEVHM17XUDB3QKR1]{Solar Surge} charges equal to half your proficiency bonus. In addition, your fur begins to glow, shedding 10ft of dim light until you expend your last @Compendium[undertaking.abilities.SEVHM17XUDB3QKR1]{Solar Surge} charge or get an hour into a long rest.
